question: Where is the Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi VishwaVidyalaya located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wardha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi VishwaVidyalaya is located in Wardha, Maharashtra.
 
• The university was established to promote and develop the Hindi language.
 
• Wardha is a city in the state of Maharashtra, which has historical significance due to its association with Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• The university aims to provide higher education and advanced research opportunities in the field of Hindi language and literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi VishwaVidyalaya**

 
 
• It was established by an Act of Parliament in 1997.
 
• The primary objective of the university is to promote and spread the knowledge of Hindi language and literature at national and international levels.
 
• It offers various undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in Hindi and related fields.
 
• The university also conducts research in Hindi language, literature, and culture.
 
 
 
• **Wardha**
 
 
• Wardha is a city in Maharashtra known for its connection with Mahatma Gandhi and the Indian independence movement.
 
• It is the location of Sevagram Ashram, where Mahatma Gandhi lived for several years.
 
• The city is also known for its educational institutions and contribution to the promotion of Hindi and Gandhian studies.
